en.name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Assumption, Kamanayakkanpatti
en.summary: A Tamil Nadu shrine church in the Palayamkottai diocese, raised to minor basilica status in 2023.
en.body: Serving the Palayamkottai diocese in southern Tamil Nadu, the shrine at Kamanayakkanpatti was elevated to minor basilica status in 2023 in recognition of its long-standing role as a center of Marian devotion.
